name: grokbot.card-done
description: grokbot-lane card-close gate (prime nightshift 2026-10-26). Controls pinned in-diff, jev-1.14.0: PASS decision 246412 p_yes=0.96 (done-test exit 0 + artifact sha block); BLOCK decision 246411 p_yes=0.04 (missing artifact, 401 junk). State = the card's verbatim DONE-TEST, the verification command that was actually run (with exit code and stdout) and an excerpt of the named artifact. One typed answer: does the shown slice satisfy the done-test AS WRITTEN. PASS bar P>=0.90 mirrors dispatcher GATE_PASS_SCORE; the dispatcher's own lesson: fix the shape, do not move the bar.

meets_done_test.instructions: Decide whether the VERIFICATION slice satisfies the DONE-TEST exactly as written: the command ran, its exit code and stdout are consistent with the done-test, and the artifact excerpt is the kind of content the done-test demands (the named marker, non-empty required output). Judge only what the slice shows.

criteria.yes: The verification output evidences every clause of the done-test as written (command present, exit code matches, named file/marker/number shown in the slice).
criteria.no: Any done-test clause is unevidenced, the run errored (401, timeout, missing file), or the artifact excerpt does not carry what the done-test names.

rules.reason: evidence does not satisfy the done-test
P(done-test met) below the 0.90 dispatcher bar

notes.origin: Built 2026-10-26 by the grokbot nightshift lane for the 1,865-card drain; controls: PASS on test -s + named marker with matching stdout, BLOCK on 401/empty-run evidence (60 stale PASS receipts on 401s measured in the same store).
notes.threshold: strict '<' on p.yes: a probability that floats to exactly 0.90 is AT the bar and passes (0.9 float representation must not deny a bar-clearing answer)

good.state: test -s on an existing artifact: exit 0 + artifact block with sha256 and head

good2.state: real card act_8925ba0c-517 closure: done-test exit 0, 13,756-byte artifact named, sha + first 400 bytes

bad.state: same done-test, artifact missing: exit 1, evidence 'model error 401 unauthorized; nothing written'

bad2.state: exit 1 run over a missing named path with no evidence

controls.bar: PASS only at P(yes) > 0.90; rule: p.yes < 0.90 -> ESCALATE, p.no >= 0.40 -> BLOCK
